title: capability_probe v1
description: Machine-readable result of an external capability probe. Result MUST be either `verified` (with evidence refs) or `conservative_unknown`. `pass`/`available` are NOT permitted.

conservative_default.description: Which conservative default is applied when result != verified.

evidence_refs.description: Points to captured evidence (fixture path, hash, doc anchor). MUST be non-empty when result=verified; MAY be empty for conservative_unknown.

sandbox_transport_loopback_http_self_rep.rationale: Loopback HTTP + self-reported agent_id is explicitly forbidden by PRD FR-17 and DESIGN C-13; no evidence can upgrade it to verified.
